claim: Civil flight above Mach 1 over U.S. land remains prohibited except under special authorization
limitation: A current legal constraint is not a physics limit and may change

claim: July 2026 NPRM proposes replacing the general speed prohibition with a performance-based interim limit and approval framework
limitation: Proposed rule is not current permission or a final community-acceptance threshold

claim: ICAO adopted new environmental standards including next-generation supersonic aircraft; applicability is prospective
limitation: Landing/takeoff standards do not resolve en-route sonic boom acceptability

claim: ICAO CAEP/14 work programme continues development of an en-route noise and sonic-boom certification scheme
limitation: No completed globally harmonized en-route certification scheme is demonstrated by this source

claim: NASA Quesst plans community surveys and regulator data delivery after flight testing
limitation: Research programme milestones are not evidence of public acceptance or commercial compliance

claim: No high-speed-specific passenger cabin-noise threshold was established in this audit
limitation: Requires a separate occupational and passenger-acoustics literature pass
